title: VITAL SECRET TO HAPPINESS

blocks.text: “In this letter I definitely feel led to write some Scriptures personally for your benefit and my partners, to encourage and let you know that Jesus is standing with you and will absolutely see you through any trouble or problems that hinder you!” “The prayerful anointing will break any pressure, yoke or sickness confronting you!” “Let’s trust together completely in His love and mercy; for He careth for His own children! Here are some Scriptures on how he will comfort and give you divine wisdom, which is a treasure of all His promises!”

St. John 14:26, “reveals the comforter is the Holy Spirit surrounding you even now, and that it’s sent in the name of the Lord Jesus revealing all things to you; plus bringing His Scriptural promises to remembrance in you! – St. John 16:7, speaks of the Comforter again, and the very Lord Jesus comes again as a comforter in the Holy Spirit! So in the name of Jesus you have all power plus 7 anointings that can work for you!” (Rev. 4:5) – “These 7 anointings are one in the Holy Spirit and in the body of the Lord Jesus!” – “Behold, saith the Lord, I will be with you in the test and the trials, in protection and health!” “Read ye this Scripture – believe” – Isa. 43:2, “When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned!” – Also Isa. 61:1-3, “The Holy Spirit will comfort all that mourn to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy in place of mourning, the garment of praise in place of heaviness!” – “Yea, thou art given exceeding great and precious promises so that you can be partakers of His divine nature in power!” (II Peter 1:4) – “Yea, I doeth great things, unsearchable, and marvelous things without number!” – “Dear Partner, Jesus loves you so much, just trust and act! Remember also that patience produces wisdom, and He does work swiftly too!”

“Fear thou not, I am with thee. Be not dismayed for I am thy God! For I have spoken Jesus shall give His angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways!” (Ps. 91:11) – “Yea, the Almighty . . . shall bless thee with blessings from heaven above! . . . Fear not, for I have redeemed thee and call thee by name, thou art mine. When thou passeth through the waters (troubles and sicknesses) I will be with thee!” (Isa. 43:1-2) – “I have spoken and you are complete in Me saith the Lord!” (Col. 2:10) – “Yea, I have seen thee so many times in tears, but ye shall also reap in great joy!” (Ps. 126:5) – “O the love and goodness of the Lord is with you, the Holy Spirit is inspiring this for your comfort and happiness!” – “Yea, as I walked in the midst of the Israelites, I will also walk in the midst of thy camp!” (Deut. 23:14) – “Whosoever trusteth in the Lord, doeth a good and upright thing!” – “For the Lord your God shall even fight for you!” (Deut. 3:22) – “For I am a stronghold in the day of trouble!” (Naum. 1:7) – “For I am strong on your behalf, cast your load upon me, for there is no burden too heavy for Me; I shall sustain thee and guide thee!”

“Here is a vital secret to happiness saith the Lord of Hosts!” Prov. 3:13. “Happy is the man that findeth wisdom and the man that getteth understanding! Yea, wisdom is given to those who fear the Lord; for this is the beginning of wisdom! And the knowledge of the Holy Spirit is understanding! (Prov. 9:10) Yea, hide My words and promises in thee, and thy ear shall receive wisdom from my Spirit! For it is a hidden treasure of the Lord to find wisdom and knowledge! For out of the mouth of the Spirit cometh knowledge, and I layeth up sound wisdom for the righteous! – (Prov. 2:1-7) – “Yea, trust in the Lord Jesus with all thine heart, and lean not unto thine own understanding. Acknowledge me and I shall not only direct thine paths, but I shall give thee wonderful wisdom to understand deep mysteries and things to come!” – “Behold these things are written through the Holy Spirit that your joy may be full!” – “Yea, and these things have I spoken unto you that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full!” (St. John 15:11) – “Behold, these things are true and faithful, hold firmly to them, let not thy days pass without them, for they are happiness and they are life unto all who believe!” – “Trust in complete patience and the Lord thy God shall give thee more knowledge and wisdom as the age closes out!” – “Dear Partner, the Lord certainly loves you, don’t fail to show your love towards Him! For all of this was given directly for you to read and be comforted! Remember His sayings!”
In Jesus’ love, protection and care,
